subject: [RFC PATCH 52/57] selftests/mm: cover a hole-y window in a sub-PMD VMA

2026-08-16.patch_summary: This patch adds a new test case to the selftests/mm suite to cover a previously untested scenario where a partially populated window in a sub-PMU VMA is collapsed. The test checks that unfaulted slots are zero-filled and faulted pages remain unchanged after collapse. The test uses the khugepaged tool to simulate the collapse operation and verify its correctness.
